card.name: Just before unit abbreviations in formulas
card.fires_on: Small words or symbols such as "(", "each", "last", "or" and "=" that come right before a unit like kg, mg or mSv in a dose calculation or table header.

modes.label: Bracket before kg
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after "Weight" or "Body Weight" that is followed by the unit kg.
modes.example: mg/kg Dose: Injection Volumes using TALVEY 3 mg/1.5 mL (2 mg/mL) Vial Body Weight<< (>>kg) Total Dose (mg)

modes.label: Per-unit wording
modes.description: Words like "each" or "last" that come just before a unit or distance in a rate or per-weight rule.
modes.example: per radioisotope activity associated with injection Organ 82 Rb 1 (mcGy/MBq) 82 Sr 2<< (>>mcGy/kBq)

modes.label: Dose formula links
modes.description: Symbols or conjunctions in a dose conversion or calculation, such as "=" or "or", just before a unit.
modes.example: Calculate the mg amount of rimantadine hydrochloride needed for the duration of therapy. (Daily Dose) × (Number of days)<< =>> (mg of rimantadine hydro
